package_info.why_malicious: This package version is malicious because it contains multiple critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities, including several with published CVEs (CVE-2019-14540, CVE-2019-14892, CVE-2019-14893, CVE-2019-16335, CVE-2019-17267). These vulnerabilities can be exploited by attackers to achieve remote code execution or data compromise if the vulnerable version is included in a project. The risks are well-documented, and security advisories explicitly warn against using this version.

malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Specifying dependencies in pom.xml is standard practice, but only with versions that are not known to be vulnerable. Using a version with active CVEs is not legitimate.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Continuously monitor build configuration files (such as pom.xml) for the addition or update of dependencies to versions with published CVEs using automated security scanners or policy enforcement tools. Flag any pull request or commit that introduces or updates dependencies to known vulnerable versions (e.g., jackson-databind:2.9.9.3, commons-fileupload:1.3.3). Correlate with security advisories and CVE databases to ensure up-to-date detection. Provide remediation guidance to upgrade to secure, patched versions and verify that no vulnerable artifacts are present in the build output.
